cs-alert-bot: ALERT: SmartStart (acct ss_721) churn-risk flagged: drop in active flows -38% over 7d. Renewal in 12 days. Tag: "usage-drop".

Maya Singh: Noted. They migrated billing flow last week and started seeing timeouts in preview. Renewal 06/02.

Tom Reynolds: Timeout stack traces show soft 504 from our gateway on route `billing-summary`. Could be batch size increase from customer's new payload.

Elena Ortiz: Customer comment via inbox: "Pages time out when previewing large orders, so we reverted to CSV upload."

Maya Singh: Immediate save plan: 1) quick hotfix to limit preview batch to 50 items per request for this tenant, 2) schedule 40m pairing to review best-practices and payload sizing, 3) offer a one-week credit and concierge run.

Tom Reynolds: I'll push a tenant-scoped config override (limit.preview_items=50) and add an alert for >20% drop in preview success. ETA 20m.

Elena Ortiz: I'll draft the customer message: short, actionable. "We rolled out a temporary config limiting preview size so your experience is stable. Can we pair for 40m tomorrow to optimize payloads and restore full flow?"

cs-alert-bot: NOTE: ticket #CS-5037 created for ss_721.

Tom Reynolds: Config override applied. Preview p95 latency back to baseline in staging smoke.

Maya Singh: Message sent and pairing scheduled for tomorrow 9am PT. Offered the one-week credit. Moving renewal risk -> "watching".

Elena Ortiz: After pairing, we'll document a short payload-size guide in onboarding repo and add it to the renewal playbook as a mitigation.

Maya Singh: Customer replied: "Thanks, preview works now. Let's meet tomorrow." Putting follow-ups in Gainsight. Closing immediate loop. :white_check_mark:
